ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a mixed‑review 1973 show that many fans deem a standout despite a few harsh critiques
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard (sbd) source that delivers clear, listenable audio, though reviewers give no detailed technical feedback. Musical reactions are split – one fan calls it a “standout performance of ’73” with a strong California vibe and high energy, another rates it poorly and urges listeners to seek the 2‑15‑73 Madison show instead, while a third offers a neutral three‑star comment.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews range from 0 to 5 stars; two reviewers praise the show heavily, one is very negative. Assuming decent soundboard quality, the overall weighted impression lands in the low‑mid “good” range.
